newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kirin shares lower on weaker forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kirin shares lower on weaker forecast.

text.p: Shares in Kirin Brewery Co Ltd dropped on Thursday morning after it said that its earnings would be lower than forecast.
The share was down 50 yen at 1,150 yen at 0055 GMT, the fourth-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was 504,000 shares.
Kirin said earlier that its sales and profits in the current business year to December 31 would not reach a forecast it made earlier in the year.
But a spokeswoman declined to provide new forecasts for 1996 sales and profits.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that Kirin's 1996 current profit would slip to 52 billion yen, mainly due to severe competition from rival beer makers.
